hero_subtext: From the Swamp to the Pines: Celebrating over 30 years of Gators in the Triangle! Triangle Gator Club is your home for all things UF in Central North Carolina.
contact_text: Questions about membership, sponsorship, or scholarships? Email us, find a board member at a club event or message us on social media!
venue_name_address: RallyPoint Sport Grill · 837 Bass Pro Ln, Cary, NC 27513
story_paragraph_1: Gator Clubs® are affiliated organizations of the UF Alumni Association and exist to support the mission of teaching, research, and service—for both the Alumni Association and the University of Florida. Gator Clubs are open to all UFAA members at no additional cost.
story_paragraph_2: We host watch parties for all football and basketball games, complete service projects that benefit our community, and raise money for our scholarship that helps Triangle Area students with their educational goals down in Gainesville.
story_paragraph_3:
Membership is simple: just show up! Use the link below to join the UFAA directly.

If you'd like to support us further, consider making a direct contribution to the Triangle Gator Club. Your donations directly fund our local student scholarship while helping cover venue reservation fees, club operating costs, and our annual TGC picnic—which is always free for all members to attend!
